 Duncan Robinson pours in 24 points Monday night 
 by Nate Miller | Pistons Correspondent | Tue, Nov 3rd 2026, 10:59am EST 
 Duncan Robinson finished with 24 points (8-11 FG, 6-9 3PT, 2-2 FT), three assists, and three steals in Monday's 124-91 win over the Hornets. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Much as he has over the first couple of weeks of the season, Robinson got it going from long range Monday night. The veteran sharpshooter set a new season-high in points, eclipsing 20 for the third time in his first seven games. Robinson is now averaging 17.9 points with 4.0 treys (45.2%) and 2.0 steals per game.
